name: hcportal_getNewsflashList
description: Returns all newsflashes, including soft-deleted ones (IsDeleted=1), for the HC Admin Tools management screen, each with a dismissedCount (number of users who clicked 'I've read it'). Ordered by CreatedAt DESC. Device-bound portal auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; the SP applies NO admin/permission gate — any signed-in portal user may call it. The admin restriction exists only in the portal UI.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with NULL callerParamString.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure (HC6.ValidatePortalAuth message) or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: NewsflashList
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows, one per newsflash, ordered by CreatedAt DESC (most recently created first). Includes soft-deleted rows (IsDeleted=1).

columns.name: imageUrl
columns.description: Optional Azure Blob URL for the header image

columns.name: startDate
columns.description: Date from which this newsflash is active

columns.name: endDate
columns.description: Optional expiry date (inclusive). NULL = no expiry.

columns.name: kennelId
columns.description: Targeted kennel ID. NULL = platform-wide newsflash.

columns.name: kennelName
columns.description: Display name of the targeted kennel. NULL when kennelId is NULL.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the newsflash was created

columns.name: dismissedCount
columns.description: Number of users who have permanently dismissed this newsflash (IsDismissed=1). 0 if no readers yet.

codeSmells.issue: No admin gate in the SP
codeSmells.detail: Lines 33-41: only ValidatePortalAuth runs. Any signed-in portal user can list every newsflash, including soft-deleted ones and those targeted at other kennels. The HC Admin Tools screen is the only thing restricting it.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 67-70: CATCH returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row.

codeSmells.issue: BIT column in a new table
codeSmells.detail: HC.PortalNewsflash.IsDeleted is BIT (created 2026-04 by db/hc6/portal/archive/create_portal_newsflash_tables.sql); house rule is SMALLINT. isDeleted reaches the client as a JSON boolean.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the ordering (CreatedAt DESC) without coordinating with the portal client
